body: Mara, gawin nating operational ang burden of proof: after an investment loss, any unsolicited 'recovery' offer that asks for another payment should trigger a payment freeze until verified through an independently obtained official channel. Huwag gamitin ang phone number, URL, QR, o account details na galing mismo sa recovery message. The goal is not to decide whether the caller sounds trustworthy; it is to remove the scammer from the verification loop entirely. Boring process, pero iyon ang point.
